name: rubber-segment
title: Rubber Segment
description: A segmented control with a bright sliding thumb. Choosing a segment stretches the thumb toward its new home, and you can drag or flick it across the track.
use: A short set of mutually exclusive options needs a compact control with a tactile, draggable indicator.
avoid: Best with three to five short labels; equal slots squeeze long words and push the track past narrow parents.
a11y: Roving tabindex with arrow and Home/End keys mirrors a native radio group; the moving thumb is hidden from assistive tech. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded track split into evenly spaced text segments, with a white rounded thumb behind the active one. A smaller three-item copy sits below; the active label is dark on white while the rest are pale on grey.
behaves: Clicking a segment stretches the thumb toward the click, then snaps it into place with a small squash. The thumb can also be grabbed and dragged along the track, and a fast flick throws it into the next slot.
customise: Items, value, default value, size, colours, radius, inset, stretch, squash, speed, glide and drag toggle are props; the spring curves live in the file.
weight: light: A handful of buttons and two animated motion values; it idles once the thumb lands.
demo: Two controls: Day/Week/Month/Year with Week selected, and Overview/Analytics/Reports with Overview selected.
polishWhy: The elastic stretch and squash feel physical and stay legible; the springs are well tuned.
